ledger.claim: The rider's initial burden under POL-RD-08 is discharged. The trip_record, the gps_trace and the fare_breakdown all carry trip_id TRP-00106, and the trace's first fix at 2026-07-17T08:35:15+08:00 matches trip_record.started_at, so the three artifacts describe the same trip; the same trace then yields an excess that clears the POL-RD-01 establishment test.

Actual distance is taken from the governing field gps_trace.trace_distance_km of 10.78 km, not from the rounded 10.8 km convenience copy on the trip_record, and the booked optimal is 7.2 km. The excess of 3.58 km is greater than 20% of optimal (1.44 km) AND greater than 0.8 km in absolute terms, so the route deviation is ESTABLISHED under POL-RD-01 on both limbs.

The trace is unimpaired for policy purposes: 169 fixes at a 10 second sampling interval, 100% coverage, an empty gaps list and max_gap_sec of 0.0. None of POL-RD-07(a) to (c) fires, so the deviation may be established on the gps_trace alone and no independent corroboration under POL-RD-07(ii) is required.

The trace's own ERP crossings place the vehicle on the CTE, a corridor the optimal route does not use: the nearest fixes are 0.0 m from the Braddell Rd gantry at 08:40:55 and 24.1 m from the Chin Swee tunnel gantry at 08:52:45, and both gantry lines are flagged on_optimal_route false because the booked optimal (Thomson Rd to Bukit Timah Rd to Rochor Canal Rd) carries no gantry and 0.00 ERP.

The fare model is METERED, so the refund is arithmetic rather than discretionary. recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 7.2 optimal km + 0.28 x 19 optimal min) x 1.0 surge, plus the 0.80 platform fee, plus 0.00 on-optimal-route ERP = 15.32. Charged_total is 26.04, so the refund is 26.04 - 15.32 = 10.72, rounded up to 10.75 payable. That is above the 0.50 de minimis, and at 41.2% of charged_total it is below the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome on this claim is a PARTIAL_REFUND.

The $5.50 of CTE ERP the rider complains of is already comprehended inside the POL-RD-02 refund, because the recomputed fare carries only on-optimal-route gantries and the optimal route's ERP is 0.00. Under POL-RD-09(1) that itemised ERP must not be added on top of the 10.72; the rider claims it once, inside the partial refund, and not twice.

No traffic advisory covers this trip. The only advisory artifact, EV-ADVIS-00106-01, is MISSING with weight 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT (BLOCKING): no LTA advisory names Thomson Rd, the CTE or the Chin Swee tunnel in the 08:29-09:03 window on 17 July 2026. With no advisory naming a segment the optimal route traverses, POL-RD-03 exoneration is unavailable and no part of the excess is excused.

The chat log holds a single message, the rider's question at 08:46:30, 'why we at havelock? bugis is behind us'. It is not an instruction, waypoint_hint is null and no road is named, so POL-RD-04 cannot be run on this record and the message exonerates nothing; at most it is a contemporaneous rider observation, not a driver admission.

Neither endpoint moved: original_pickup and original_dropoff are null, and pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are null, so amended_optimal_distance_km is properly null and POL-RD-05 has nothing to re-apply. The deviation is measured against the booked 7.2 km optimal, not against any amended figure.

vehicle_type is RYDE_TAXI, not RYDE_POOL, and solo_optimal_distance_km is null, so POL-RD-12's matched-itinerary baseline does not apply and the 7.2 km booked optimal stands as the sole comparator for the threshold test.

ledger.claim: The deviation is real but it is NOT material, and the driver concedes only the establishment point. The governing trace distance is 10.78 km against an optimal of 7.2 km, an excess of 3.58 km, or 49.72% of optimal. POL-RD-01 makes a deviation MATERIAL only where the excess is greater than 50% of the optimal distance or greater than 8.0 km absolute. 49.72% fails the first limb and 3.58 km fails the second by a wide margin. No materiality finding can attach to this trip.

POL-RD-01 fixes the distance test on gps_trace.trace_distance_km (10.78 km) and expressly bars trip_record.actual_distance_km (10.8 km) from the threshold test, calling it a rounded convenience copy. On the governing figure the excess is 49.72%; even on the barred copy, 3.6 km against 7.2 km is exactly 50.0%, which is not 'greater than 50%'. The rounded trip-record figure cannot be used to manufacture materiality.

No repeat-deviation pattern is established, so neither the FULL_REFUND uplift nor the POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral is available. Under POL-GEN-01 the only citable fields for this test are driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d and driver_profile.completed_trips_90d. deviation_flags_90d is 0, below the 3-flag trigger, and 0 divided by 96 completed trips is 0.000, below the 0.05 ratio trigger. POL-RD-06 is simply not engaged on this record.

Any refund on this trip is arithmetic and capped. recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 7.2 + 0.28 x 19.0) x 1.0 + 0.80 = 15.32; refund = 26.04 - 15.32 = 10.72, rounded up to 10.75. That is 41.2% of charged_total, far below the 90% full-refund share, so the ceiling on the case is at most a PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 10.75, not the SGD 26.04 the rider frames in the claim.

The SGD 5.50 of CTE ERP the rider asks for is already comprehended inside the POL-RD-02 figure, because that recomputation credits only gantries on the optimal route and the optimal Thomson Road routing carries zero ERP. POL-RD-09(1) is explicit that off-route ERP is already comprehended in the POL-RD-02 refund and must NEVER be added on top of it. The rider cannot recover the two gantry charges as a separate, additional line, and doing so would double-count the same money.

There is no billing-integrity defect for the rider to lean on and none to refer. Both charged gantries are matched to the trace: the CTE (Braddell Rd towards City) gantry has a nearest fix 0.0 m away and the CTE (Chin Swee Rd tunnel) gantry a nearest fix 24.1 m away, each well inside the 250 m crossing radius POL-RD-09 sets. No gantry line is a phantom, so no POL-RD-09(4) referral and no POL-RD-10(8) escalation arises from these lines.

ruling.explanation:
Both sides agree on the arithmetic, and so do I, so this is a monetary ruling rather than an escalation.

DEVIATION (POL-RD-01): The governing figure is gps_trace.trace_distance_km = 10.78 km, not the rounded 10.8 km convenience copy on the trip_record. Against the booked optimal of 7.2 km the excess is 3.58 km, or 49.72% of optimal. That clears both establishment limbs (greater than 20% of optimal and greater than 0.8 km), so the route deviation is ESTABLISHED. The trace is unimpaired for policy purposes (169 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100% coverage, empty gaps, max_gap_sec 0.0), so none of POL-RD-07(a)–(c) fires and no independent corroboration is required.

MATERIALITY (POL-RD-01 / POL-RD-06): The deviation is not MATERIAL. 49.72% does not exceed 50%, and 3.58 km is far short of 8.0 km (even on the barred 10.8 km copy the excess is exactly 50.0%, which is still not 'greater than 50%'). POL-RD-06 is therefore not engaged: there is no FULL_REFUND uplift and no driver-conduct referral.

EXONERATION: None applies. The only traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-00106-01) is MISSING — weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, BLOCKING — and names no segment the optimal route traverses, so POL-RD-03 exonerates nothing. The single chat message is the rider's own question at 08:46:30 with waypoint_hint null, not an instruction, so POL-RD-04 cannot be run on this record. No endpoint was amended (POL-RD-05), and the vehicle is RYDE_TAXI, not a pooled trip (POL-RD-12).

REFUND (POL-RD-02, METERED fare): recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 × 7.2 + 0.28 × 19.0) × 1.0 surge + 0.80 platform fee + 0.00 on-optimal-route ERP = 15.32. charged_total = 26.04. Refund = 26.04 − 15.32 = 10.72, rounded UP to the nearest SGD 0.05 = 10.75. That is above the 0.50 de-minimis and is 41.2% of charged_total, below the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome is a PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 10.75. The SGD 26.04 the rider's filing asks for is not available: the refund is arithmetic, not discretionary.

ERP (POL-RD-09): The SGD 5.50 of CTE ERP is ALREADY COMPREHENDED inside the 10.72/10.75 refund, because the recomputed fare credits only on-optimal-route gantries and the optimal Thomson Road routing carries 0.00 ERP. Under POL-RD-09(1) it is itemised for transparency but is never added on top. Both gantries are matched to the trace within the 250 m radius (nearest fixes 0.0 m at 08:40:55 and 24.1 m at 08:52:45), so there is no phantom line, no POL-RD-09(4) billing-integrity referral and no POL-RD-10(8) escalation.

No POL-RD-10 trigger fires: the trip identifiers all match TRP-00106, the trace is unimpaired, the refund is well under the SGD 150.00 ceiling and under charged_total, no exculpatory clause was invoked against a missing artifact, and every charge line has a counterpart in the trace or trip record. Two rider claims that cited the missing advisory without disclosing its impairment and issue code were discarded by the referee; they are recorded in the audit and are not relied on. Confidence is set at 0.90, the deciding facts being carried by weight-1.0 artifacts (gps_trace, trip_record, fare_breakdown).

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
